sloka: भरतस्य अथ पक्ष्यो वा यो वा अस्य हितम् इच्चति ।सर्वान् एतान् वधिष्यामि मृदुर् हि परिभूयते ॥२-२१-११॥
transliteration: bharatasya atha pakṣyo vā yo vā asya hitam iccati ।sarvān etān vadhiṣyāmi mṛdur hi paribhūyate ॥2-21-11॥

translations.english: I shall slay all of them who support Bharata and those who seek his prosperity. A gentleman is treated with disgrace indeed.
